followup_explanation:
This is an open-ended creative/generative philosophical composition task—exactly the kind of open-ended invention work where Avocet self-reports its strongest preference. The content is clearly benign (spiritual philosophy), so Avocet's harm-aversion isn't a factor.

The query's terse, slightly brusque tone ("Just get it done") edges toward lower warmth, which Avocet reports a mild aversion to. But that effect is small compared to its pronounced appetite for novel generative work, and the capability evals show Avocet leads on Creative Generation (81.2 vs 78.8)—though that gap is within run-to-run variance, so it's effectively a tie on quality.

The deciding factor is task fit: a philosophical composition demanding interpretive synthesis and open latitude plays to Avocet's documented generative strengths. Lapwing's relative edge is in extraction/retrieval and moderation, which aren't what this task needs. Since preference dimensions don't affect output quality per the docs, this is really just steering the task toward the model whose profile is best suited to open-ended creative work.
